description:
I-Find My Phone - Family Locator ikusiza ukuthi uhlale uxhumekile futhi uqinisekise ukuphepha kwamalungu omndeni wakho. Sisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe be-GPS obuthuthukisiwe, uhlelo lwethu lokusebenza lunikeza izibuyekezo zendawo zesikhathi sangempela, okukuvumela ukuthi uthole kalula amalungu omndeni wakho futhi uwathole ezixukwini ngefoni yakho.

Izici ezibalulekile zokuphepha komndeni nokuxhumana:
✔️ Ukulandelela indawo yesikhathi sangempela: buka indawo ebukhoma yamalungu omndeni wakho kumephu yangasese.

✔️ Izexwayiso zokufika nokuhamba: thola isaziso lapho amalungu omndeni efika noma eshiya izindawo ezichazwe kusengaphambili (isb., ekhaya, esikoleni).

Inkinobho ye-✔️ SOS: yabelana ngendawo yakho yesimo esiphuthumayo ngokushesha nombuthano wakho othembekile.

✔️ Ukulandelela izindiza: yazi kalula ukuthi amalungu embuthano yakho andizela kuphi futhi uthole izaziso.

✔️ Ingxoxo yangasese yangaphakathi nohlelo lokusebenza: hlala uxhumana nomndeni wakho ngemiyalezo ephephile.

✔️ Ukungena okusheshayo: yazisa amalungu omndeni ukuthi uphephile ngokuthepha.

✔️ Umlando wendawo: buyekeza izindawo zangaphambilini zamalungu omndeni.

📲 Indlela Yokuthola Ucingo Lwami - I-Family Locator Esebenza Ngayo:

1. Faka uhlelo lokusebenza bese unikeza izimvume ezidingekayo ukuze uhlelo lokusebenza lusebenze (isb., ukufinyelela indawo).

2. Dala noma ujoyine umbuthano womndeni oyimfihlo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu obamemayo kuphela nabamukela isimemo sakho abazoba yingxenye yombuthano wakho.

3. Mema umndeni noma amalungu athembekile usebenzisa inombolo yawo yocingo, isixhumanisi esiqondile, noma ikhodi ye-QR.

4. Imvume ecacile ibalulekile: Ilungu ngalinye elimenyiwe kumele lamukele isimemo ngokusobala kuphela ngemvume futhi linikeze zonke izimvume ezidingekayo (kufaka phakathi ukufinyelela indawo) kudivayisi yalo ngaphambi kokuba ukwabelana ngendawo kusebenze kubo.

5. Izaziso ezicacile: Wonke amalungu aziswe ngokucacile ngenhloso yohlelo lokusebenza, ukuthi ubani owamemile, nokuthi idatha yendawo yawo izosetshenziswa kanjani ngaphakathi kombuthano oyimfihlo.

6. Ukulawula komsebenzisi: Thola Ucingo Lwami - I-Family Locator ingasebenza kuphela uma umsebenzisi ngamunye evuma ngenkuthalo ukwabelana ngendawo yakhe.

🔒 Ubumfihlo, Ukucaca kanye Nemvume Yomsebenzisi:

I-Family Locator isekela kuphela ukusetshenziswa okuhlangene, okunolwazi, nokusobala kokwabelana ngendawo phakathi kwamaqembu avumelanayo - njengamalungu omndeni kanye nabantu oxhumana nabo abaseduze. Uhlelo lwethu lokusebenza lwakhiwe ngezimiso zobumfihlo, ukuphepha, kanye nokuthembana.

Sikhuthaza abasebenzisi ukuthi basebenzise i-Find My Phone - Family Locator kuphela ezimweni zokusetshenziswa kokuphepha komndeni kanye nokunakekela. Ukusetshenziswa kabi kohlelo lokusebenza kokulandelela okungavunyiwe kanye/noma ngaphandle kwemvume enolwazi kuphambene kakhulu nezinqubomgomo zethu kanye nemithetho yobumfihlo yendawo.

Izimvume ezingakhethwa: 
- Thola Ucingo Lwami - I-Family Locator ingacela izimvume ezilandelayo (ngokuvunyelwa komsebenzisi esinyathelweni ngasinye):

- Izinsizakalo zendawo: zokwabelana ngendawo ngesikhathi sangempela, i-geofencing, kanye nezaziso ze-SOS.

- Izaziso: ukukwazisa ngezinguquko zendawo yomndeni kanye nezaziso zokuphepha.
- Oxhumana nabo: ukukusiza umeme amalungu omndeni athembekile emibuthanweni yakho.
- Izithombe neKhamera: ukwenza ngezifiso isithombe sakho sephrofayela.

Izimvume zicelwa ngokusobala futhi zichazwe ngokomongo. Abasebenzisi bahlala belawula ngaso sonke isikhathi futhi bangalungisa ukufinyelela kuzilungiselelo zedivayisi.

I-Family Locator izibophezele ekuvikelekeni, ekuhlelweni, nasekusetshenzisweni okunesibopho. Asisekeli noma yikuphi ukusetshenziswa kohlelo lokusebenza ngaphandle kolwazi nemvume yabo bonke abahlanganyeli.

I-Find My Phone - I-Family Locator ayihloselwe ukulandelela ngasese noma ukuqapha okungagunyaziwe. Yakhelwe futhi ithengiswa kuphela ezimweni zokusetshenziswa kokuphepha komndeni, njengokulandelela abazali izingane noma abanakekeli abasiza abaxhomeke kubo. Ayisekeli ukulandelela okuyimfihlo, ukufakwa okuyimfihlo, noma ukusebenza okukude.
